thought.text: The display server is running end-to-end: it's signed in with the self-hosted Biletado backend, the cache updates are working, and the resource page is displaying the reservation info for the day I seeded ("03:11 – 05:11 TABS-FASU"). Running the final verification: the exact command from the guide, multi-resource IDs, 404 behavior, and container stability.

reasoning_content:
Excellent! The display server is working end-to-end:
- `BASE URL: http://backend:8081/api` — connected to the self-hosted Biletado backend
- `Updated bookings cache.` — the fetch loop is running
- `/resources/Raum%20A` → 200, HTML showing "Raum A", status FREI, and the upcoming booking "03:11 – 05:11 TABS-FASU" (booking for today).

Note: The booking ID (TABS-FASU) is displayed instead of the name "Max Mustermann" — the template is probably using the booking id or something. In any case, the reservation is showing up.

Wait — the displayed times are 03:11–05:11 in Berlin time (UTC+1), which is consistent with "1 hour from now + 2 hours" (at the time of reservation, current UTC was ~02:11). Correct.

Let me also verify the multi-resource `ids` page content and the 404 for an unknown resource. Also, I'll confirm the container stays up (no restarts). Then I'll also do a final verification using the exact commands in the guide:
- `curl http://localhost:8001/resources/{resource}` — done (200)
- `curl 'http://localhost:8001/resources?ids=...'` — done (200)

Let me check the status line of the ids page, confirm the container's uptime, and re-verify that the booking appears in the ids page as well. Also confirm that the exit code of the single-resource curl was 0.

One more check: the guide says "resources?ids={resource_A}|{resource_B}|..." — pipe character. Let me test the URL encoding of ids=A|B. And test that an unknown resource returns 404 (documented behavior in the TODO list).

After that, I'll finalize. Also, I should double-check `docker compose ps` for the display server — that it's been up and stable for several minutes, not restarting.

Also, let me record the full final verification with exit codes.

action.command:
cd /workspace
echo "--- guide cmd 1: single resource ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' 'http://localhost:8001/resources/Raum%20A'; echo "curl exit=$?"
echo "--- guide cmd 2: ids (two resources) ---"
curl -s -o /tmp/ids2.html -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' 'http://localhost:8001/resources?ids=Raum%20A|Raum%20A'; echo "curl exit=$?"
grep -c "Raum A" /tmp/ids2.html
echo "--- unknown resource (expect 404) ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' 'http://localhost:8001/resources/Nonexistent'
echo "--- container stability ---"
docker compose ps
docker inspect --format '{{.RestartCount}} restarts, state={{.State.Status}}' display-server
